criteria.name: Correct Output
criteria.description: Program produces correct FizzBuzz output for numbers 1-100

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All 100 lines correct: prints 'Fizz' for multiples of 3, 'Buzz' for multiples of 5, 'FizzBuzz' for multiples of both, and the number otherwise

levels.label: Mostly Correct
levels.description: Minor errors in output (1-5 incorrect lines)

levels.label: Partial
levels.description: Some correct output but significant errors (6-20 incorrect lines)

levels.label: Attempting
levels.description: Shows understanding of concept but mostly incorrect output

levels.label: Missing
levels.description: No output or completely wrong approach

criteria.name: Code Structure
criteria.description: Code uses proper control flow and logic structure

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Uses efficient conditional logic, checks divisibility by 15 first (or equivalent), clean loop structure

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Correct logic but slightly inefficient (e.g., redundant checks)

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Works but uses poor structure (deeply nested, repeated code)

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Follows PEP 8, meaningful variable names, proper spacing and indentation

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Several style issues but code is readable

levels.label: Poor
levels.description: Many style issues, hard to read

criteria.name: Documentation
criteria.description: Code includes appropriate comments and docstrings

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: Has module docstring, function docstring (if applicable), and helpful inline comments

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Has some documentation but missing elements
